{{Quote|Do you have any of the following symptoms: dizziness, fever, shortness of breath or an inexhaustible hunger for sentient flesh?|CB-08-4, questioning patients to determine the presence of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''CB-08-4''' was a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] operating on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Its primary field of research and treatment was the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], and it ran the primary [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] of [[Bomber command post|Waypoint Station Draay]].
